message.text: We've seen it. The page looks empty, and the "say anything" box filed your words on the Dictate card, so no replies showed up here. Both are being fixed now: every card's overview, and making that box send your words to the card you're looking at.

Fixed on every card. System design now shows its 4 landed tasks as delivered and its 7 sub-cards by their real titles (Servex, Hooks, Agents and roles…), and AI dashboard reads 9 of 12 and Dictate 11 of 13.

Results are on this card's overview: 4 landed tasks shown as delivered, and 7 sub-cards (Servex, Hooks, Agents and roles, Tiers, Dispatcher, Cards, Restart and revival). If you meant a different result, say which one.
"results." has arrived here four times in a row. It's probably Whisper inventing a word from silence, like its "thank you" habit, and the mic may still be on.

**How the broken links got through**

| Step | What happened | Why nothing caught it |
|---|---|---|
| content-ui built the tiles | 7 links to /framework/ai/…/<slug>/ (folder URL, not the page's address) | It checked the card loaded, never clicked a tile |
| Landing check | Screenshots and padding only | Doesn't follow links |
| smoke.mjs at merge | Loads /framework/, /framework/ai2/ + paths the agent lists | Only the pages it's told; doesn't follow links |

**The fix (automatic, in merge.mjs, nothing to remember)**
- merge.mjs works out the changed pages itself from the branch's diff (every page.js / page.jsonl touched).
- smoke.mjs opens each one AND follows every same-site link on it, one level deep: any 404 or "Page load error" fails the merge.
- Every NEW page gets a 1920 screenshot saved with the merge.

**A nightly full crawl: yes**
- ~1,140 pages under /framework/, one width, links followed: about 30 min of machine time, $0 in tokens (no model).
- Only broken links, errors and flagged layouts go to the to-do list; a model looks only at those (cents).

Building the merge change now through one small task mastermind.

- Terminal pop-ups → task-mastermind-hidden-windows (priority): reproduce from a parent with no console, fix every launcher, and enforce it in the syntax guard plus a repo-wide window lint.
- Broken links → task-mastermind-smoke-links: merge.mjs finds changed pages and follows their links, and new pages get a screenshot.

Taken. Task open at ai/2026-09-28/hidden-windows/. Plan: reproduce the popup from a no-console parent (to check the systems architect's theory), fix every launcher (on-landing.mjs, ledger.mjs, clarity.mjs callers, text-check, whatever else turns up), then enforce it — extend syntax-guard's hidden_guard and add a repo-wide window-lint.mjs. Working solo in the main tree unless the fix needs a worktree.

Taken: the System design row vanishing from the inbox. One builder reproduces it headless in a separate copy of the site (append a line, watch the row), fixes it so the row only updates in place, and I test before it goes live.

Concept tile links fixed: href() now uses the page's own address (this.page.url) instead of where its files live (folder_url()), so all 7 tiles resolve at /framework/ai2/2026/09/24/system-design/<slug>/ instead of 404ing at /framework/ai/... — proved headless: loaded the card, loaded and clicked every tile, zero errors, screenshot at 1920.

Found it. It's not a Node spawn bug — every detached+windowsHide spawn tested, even from a genuinely console-less parent, showed 0 visible windows. The real source: the "Servex" logon scheduled task runs `powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden`, and PowerShell hides its own window a moment AFTER Windows already shows it — a proven flash (reproduced by triggering the real task and watching for it). Fix: wrap the launch in a small .vbs (wscript.exe never has a console at all) — proven 0 visible windows. Two minions now: one applying that fix + a proper per-call enforcement check, one sweeping ~17 files with missing windowsHide the new repo-wide window-lint.mjs found. One thing I can't do myself: re-registering the live scheduled task needs your login password (schtasks asked for it and I backed off) — I'll leave the exact one-paste command in Servex/readme.md for you.

Fixed. Cause: another agent saved a page module at 11:00:21, which reloaded your AI 2 tab, and after a reload a group had no time until its members were read, so this row sorted near the bottom for a few seconds, then jumped back. The log was never rewritten. Now a group's time comes from the card index, which arrives with the first rows. Proof on the live site: the row is in view from the first paint on 3 reloads (before: 5 seconds off screen), and zero errors on the inbox, a card, this card and Now. Picture: /framework/ai/2026-09-28/ai2-row-vanish/rail-1920.png

Landed. The popup's real cause: the Windows logon task that starts Servex runs `powershell -WindowStyle Hidden`, and PowerShell hides its own window a moment after Windows already shows it — proven by triggering the task and watching a real console appear. Fixed with a small .vbs wrapper (wscript.exe never has a console at all) — proven 0 visible windows. Also swept 17 files missing windowsHide and made the enforcement check (syntax-guard's hidden_guard) check every call instead of a rough per-file count, so a real gap can't hide behind an unrelated call in the same file. One thing left for you: re-pointing the actual running scheduled task needs your login password — the exact one-paste command is in Servex/readme.md, "Surviving a reboot." Full report: public/framework/ai/2026-09-28/hidden-windows/

Landed. One real cause found and fixed (the Servex logon task flashing a console — see earlier note). A second lead (a Playwright/Chromium popup) didn't reproduce after three faithful tries, so instead of more guessing there's now a live, hidden, always-on catcher (Server/window-watch.mjs) that logs any new console/browser window with its full process chain the next time it happens. Enforcement is in and hand-tested: every spawn/exec call gets checked individually now, not just a rough per-file count. Full report: public/framework/ai/2026-09-28/hidden-windows/
